The '''Hutt Jeweler's Guild''' was a guild of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] that specialized in the grading and valuation of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]], including [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krann]].<ref name="For a Few Kilotons More">''{{WEGCite|story=For a Few Kilotons More|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}''</ref>
